title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 — Section 24 (Illegal strikes and lock-outs)

content.overview: Section 24 declares a strike or lock-out illegal if it is commenced or continued in contravention of sections 22 or 23, or in breach of a settlement or award.
content.glance: Section 24 declares a strike or lock-out illegal if it is commenced or continued in contravention of sections 22 or 23, or in breach of a settlement or award.
content.study: A strike or lock-out is illegal if it contravenes section 22 or 23, or if it is continued in breach of a binding settlement or award. A lock-out declared in consequence of an illegal strike, and a strike declared in consequence of an illegal lock-out, are treated separately.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 24 declares a strike or lock-out illegal if it is commenced or continued in contravention of sections 22 or 23, or in breach of a settlement or award.
